projectState.summary: First Song Library slice is implemented on codex/byte-song-library-a. The top bar now exposes a user song library (New song, Previous/Next, rename) instead of foregrounding the three canned materials. The old Lantern/Switchback/Glass materials remain hidden starter templates for compatibility and in-scale playback. Each library song has its own stable id, title, base starter material, editor branch editor-<librarySongId>, and evolving branch dial-<librarySongId>, so saved ideas and autonomous evolution can diverge per named song. Switching/creating songs uses the existing cleanup/refresh path. Validation: npm run build, npm run smoke (78/78), npm run db:smoke, git diff --check all green; npm audit still reports the known Vite/esbuild advisories.
